items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Risk severity: high for public exposure/security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release approvals, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is unknown. Compliance is technical-only at 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, authorize only bounded reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, claims, and platform-policy boundaries, and continue existing read-only evidence work. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Handoff: retain the existing bounded fleet security evidence matrix. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Create no duplicate work or production change.
